component.name: Cairo QML Clock
component.summary: A cairo-clock replacement built with Qt6 QML

description.p: A modern reimplementation of MacSlow's cairo-clock using Qt6 QML. Runs on modern Linux systems without deprecated dependencies.

ul.li: 30 themes organized in favorites, bundled, and custom folders
Smooth sweep second hand (60 fps)
Frameless transparent window with drag support on X11
Right-click menu with Properties, Info, and Quit
Size presets and custom size via spinboxes
Show seconds, show date (European DD/MM format), 24-hour mode
Keep on top and sticky workspace (X11 and Wayland with XWayland)
Theme-aware hand colors with automatic correction
GTK-friendly appearance on non-KDE desktops

screenshot.caption: Three clock themes running on a Linux desktop
Properties dialog showing theme, size, and display options

ul.li: Flatpak now builds a compiled C++ launcher instead of copying the qml interpreter from the SDK
QML install path configured at build time via configure_file, supporting both Flatpak and native installs
Size preset dropdown now correctly shows Custom for non-preset clock sizes
Sticky workspace note in Properties dialog fixed for GTK desktops (replaced Text with Label)
Removed vestigial stickWorkspace property that was never acted on
Added ThemeImage component for graceful fallback when theme images fail to load
Converted hand color loading to asynchronous XHR
Fixed Properties dialog scrolling and minimum height
Fixed theme folder and theme dropdown synchronization
Updated to Flatpak runtime org.kde.Platform 6.9
Clock now appears on all workspaces on X11 and Wayland (with XWayland)
About dialog auto-sizes to fit content on all screen densities
Switched to io.github.rappel12 app ID for Flathub submission
Properties and Info dialogs are now movable on Wayland
Context menu dismisses on click-outside on both X11 and Wayland
GTK-friendly appearance on non-KDE desktops (Adwaita style)
Self-contained Flatpak — no host Qt6 required
